epistemic_status.label: CROSS_ARM_INSPIRED_POST_SERIOUS_CHECKPOINT

generators.D6_behavior: invariant under Euclidean D6 isometries and under frozen oriented-D6 action
generators.domain: oriented packet with k>=1 and ell_edge>0
generators.k_dependence: explicit denominator k; numerator depends on endpoint displacement
generators.name: WHOLE_CHORD_RATIO_STAR

generators.D6_behavior: invariant under orientation-preserving D6 motions; under reflection the geometric pseudoscalar sign flips unless the arm's frozen oriented-D6 convention restores orientation, in which case the operator value is invariant
generators.domain: oriented packet with k>=1 and ell_edge>0
generators.k_dependence: explicit 1/k density normalization plus packet-geometry dependence
generators.name: SIGNED_AREA_DENSITY_STAR
generators.reversal_behavior: odd under unrepaired plain path reversal; sign flips
generators.short_word_convention: defined normally; for k=1 the closed packet has zero area
generators.sign_convention: positive for CCW-oriented bulge area relative to the closing endpoint chord, negative for the opposite side, zero for zero oriented closure area

generators.D6_behavior: invariant under the frozen turn-sign/D6 convention
generators.domain: packet turn-sign word of length m=max(k-1,0)
generators.k_dependence: only through m and the turn-word adjacency pattern; no chord-length amplitude
generators.name: RUN_SWITCH_DENSITY_STAR
generators.reversal_behavior: even under reversal of the turn word

generators.k_dependence: explicit k normalization and endpoint displacement dependence
generators.name: CHORD_DEFECT_RATIO_STAR
generators.short_word_convention: defined normally; for a single edge k=1 it is 0
generators.sign_convention: nonnegative for nearest-neighbor packets by triangle inequality
generators.zero_set: L_chord=k*ell_edge; equivalently equality in the polygonal triangle inequality

generators.domain: intersection of RUN_SWITCH_DENSITY_STAR and CHORD_DEFECT_RATIO_STAR domains
generators.k_dependence: inherits turn-topology dependence and normalized chord-defect dependence
generators.name: RUN_DEFECT_STAR

generators.D6_behavior: future deployable correction must respect the arm's frozen D6/oriented-D6 contract
generators.domain: any future scalar correction delta_length expressed in the same Euclidean length unit as ell_edge, packet k>=1
generators.name: DELTA_LENGTH_STAR
generators.reversal_behavior: future fitted correction must be a scalar under the declared packet symmetry; basis construction may contain the signed-area pseudoscalar only with the arm's frozen orientation convention
generators.sign_convention: inherits the signed correction convention of delta_length

implementation_requirements.A: Compute ell_edge_A and signed_area from the frozen axial carrier using R057X_CARRIER_UNIT_CONVERSION_REGISTRY; do not reuse raw A2/k as if it were already STAR-normalized.
implementation_requirements.G: Compute ell_edge_G and signed_area from the frozen G axial/embedded carrier using R057X_CARRIER_UNIT_CONVERSION_REGISTRY; do not assume a legacy stored signed-area field has the STAR normalization unless independently shown.
implementation_requirements.common_chord: Use exact endpoint displacement and Q before any numerical square-root evaluation required for scoring.
implementation_requirements.legacy_coefficients: No legacy A/G coefficient belongs to this basis without a new within-arm refit.

packet_notation.L_chord: Euclidean length ||p_k-p_0|| after the arm-specific exact carrier-to-Euclidean conversion
packet_notation.ell_edge: positive Euclidean length of one carrier nearest-neighbor boundary edge, derived per arm from its frozen carrier
packet_notation.k_domain: integer k>=1 for operator semantics; future transfer uses each arm's frozen K scope
packet_notation.packet: B=(p_0,...,p_k), a contiguous oriented boundary packet with k nearest-neighbor edges
packet_notation.signed_area: oriented Euclidean area of the polygonal packet p_0->...->p_k closed by the endpoint chord p_k->p_0; CCW-positive under the frozen traversal orientation
packet_notation.switches: number of indices j in {1,...,m-1} for which the declared turn sign changes between consecutive nonzero signed-turn symbols under the arm's frozen turn-sign reduction; no cyclic wraparound inside an open packet

short_word_convention.reason: There is no adjacent pair of turn symbols to compare.

stop_rule: After freezing the three Stage-C0 protocol artifacts, stop for Driver. Do not authorize or execute A/G refitting in Stage C0.
